segments.en: This refers to Rabbainu's holy Sipuray Ma'asiyos — the story-tales — which contain seventy dimensions of Torah meaning and have the power to raise souls that have fallen into the deepest impurity.

segments.he: לִכְבוֹד אֲדוֹנֵנוּ מוֹרֵנוּ וְרַבֵּנוּ הָרַב רַבִּי נַחְמָן זֵכֶר צַדִּיק לִבְרָכָה וְתַלְמִידוֹ הַמֻּבְהָק הָרַב רַבִּי נָתָן זֵכֶר צַדִּיק לִבְרָכָה נְגִידִים אֲדַבֵּר.
segments.en: "Silence is his praise" — the classic phrase (from Tehillim 65:2) indicating that which transcends all speech.

segments.he: וְלִכְבוֹד סִפְרֵיהֶם הַקְּדוֹשִׁים וְחִבּוּרֵיהֶם הַיְקָרִים שִׁיר יְדִידוּת אֲחַבֵּר.
segments.en: The two phrases are taken from the Kedushah prayer — the angels ask "where is the place of His glory?" while the earthly response proclaims "the whole earth is full of His glory." Rabbainu, standing between the heavenly and earthly worlds, conveyed the answer to both.

segments.he: אֶת עֹצֶם נִפְלְאוֹת עֲבוֹדָתָם לְפָאֵר וּלְהַדֵּר.
segments.en:
Let me now sing of our Beloved — what He has done for our souls,
    to rectify our covenant, to make good our latter end:
    — He is our Rabbainu.

segments.he: וְאֶת נוֹרְאוֹת תּוֹרָתָם וְהַשָּׂגָתָם לְהַגְדִּיל תּוֹרָה וּלְהַאֲדִיר.
segments.en:
Our master, our teacher — the light of our eyes —
    he illuminated the Torah for us and brought us out from darkness to light:
    — He is our Rabbainu.

segments.he: וּמִתּוֹךְ סֵפֶר שִׁבְחֵי הָרַ"ן וְסִפּוּרֵי מַעֲשִׂיּוֹת אֲלַקֵּט צִצִּים וּפְרָחִים לְהוֹדִיעַ וּלְבָרֵר.
segments.en:
His true and trustworthy counsels — to bring souls out from the lowest depths of She'ol,
    to transform their descents into ascents, and their sins into merits:
    — He is our Rabbainu.

segments.he: וְאֶת אַנְשֵׁי שְׁלוֹמֵנוּ קְטַנֵּי עֵרֶךְ כָּמוֹנִי וּמְעוּטֵי שֵׂכֶל וַחֲסֵרֵי מַעֲשֶׂה לְהַשְׁמִיעַ וּלְהַזְכִּיר.
segments.en:
Great is his compassion upon us — to bring us out from our iniquity,
    even though we are as we are — he has made known to us that Hashem is with us:
    — He is our Rabbainu.

segments.he: וְאֶת לְבָבֵינוּ הֶעָרֵל מֵהַבְלֵי עוֹלָם וּמִתַּרְדֵּמַת הַזְּמַן לְהִתְעוֹרֵר.
segments.en:
The words of faith that he instilled within us — they will give us life,
    they will strengthen our souls — to endure whatever passes over us:
    — He is our Rabbainu.

segments.he: לְמַעַן אֶת שְׁנֵי הָעוֹלָמוֹת הָעוֹבֵר וְהַנִּצְחִי לֹא נְאַבֵּד וְנַפְשֵׁנוּ לֹא יֵלֵךְ לְכִלָּיוֹן וּלְגַמֵּר.
segments.en:
The hisbodedus and prayers he taught us — to speak between ourselves and our Maker —
    they will complete our rectification and triumph over our enemies:
    — He is our Rabbainu.

segments.he: וּלְמַעַן אֶת נַפְשׁוֹתֵינוּ לְנַפְשׁוֹתֵיהֶם הַקְּדוֹשִׁים נִשְׁתַּדֵּל לְקַשֵּׁר וּלְחַבֵּר.
segments.en:
The verbal confession of each person before him — it will atone his iniquities,
    it will illuminate for him the Infinite Light — to know that all his life-events are for good:
    — He is our Rabbainu.

segments.he: וְהוּא כַּאֲשֶׁר נָשִׂים דַּעְתֵּנוּ לְסִפְרֵיהֶם הַקְּדוֹשִׁים לְחַבְּרָם בִּגְמָר וַהֲדַר סֵבֶר.
וְאֶת דַּרְכֵיהֶם הַקְּדוֹשִׁים וְאֶת עֲצוֹתֵיהֶם הַיְּקָרוֹת לֵילֵךְ בָּהֶם אֶת עַצְמוֹתֵנוּ נִשְׁמֹר.
אוּלַי נִזְכֶּה עַל יִצְרֵנוּ הָרָע לִגְבֹּר וְאֶת טִפְּשׁוּת לְבָבֵינוּ וְטִבְעַת טִבְעֵנוּ לְשַׁבֵּר.
segments.en:
We have tasted that his commerce is good — his lamp shall not go out in the night;
    forever we shall walk by his light — through Reb Noson his disciple:
    — He is our Rabbainu.
    The verse "his lamp shall not go out in the night" (Prov. 31:18) is applied here to the eternal burning light of Rabbainu's Torah — transmitted to the world through Moharan'as, Reb Noson of Breslov.

segments.he: וְאָז נִזְכֶּה גַּם אֲנַחְנוּ בָּעוֹלָם הַנִּצְחִי אֶת נַפְשׁוֹתֵינוּ בִּצְרוֹר הַחַיִּים לִצְרֹר.
וְאֶפְשָׁר נִזְכֶּה שֶׁגַּם הַגּוּף יָנוּחַ בְּשָׁלוֹם בַּקֶּבֶר עֲדֵי יָקוּם בַּתְּחִיָּה כַּאֲשֶׁר בְּעָפָר יִתְבָּרֵר.
פעה"ק יְרוּשָׁלִַם תובב"א בִּשְׁנַת תרס"ז לְפ"ק
segments.en:
Likutay Moharan — which our Rabbainu bequeathed to us — opens the locked sinews of our heart's hardness,
    so that we not be caught in the net of our enemy, and that our days and years not be slept away:
    — He is our Rabbainu.
